title: Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia Manga Miniseries Ends in Next Chapter
content: This year's 43rd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Thursday Hiro Mashima 's Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia manga miniseries will end in the next chapter in the 44th issue on September 30. The miniseries launched in this year's 35th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine on July 29.
author: ANN

title: Gachiakuta Drops New Look at Coolest Release Ahead of Season 2 – Watch Trailer
content: Gachiakuta emerged as one of the best anime of 2025 on Crunchyroll, revolutionizing the shonen anime genre with its dark approach to the medium. The anime adaptation by Studio Bones continued to prove that it was one of the best new anime series of the year with its 24-episode run, which began in the Summer 2025…

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses Hotel Inhumans Season 2, Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2, The Vermillion Mask Anime
content: Ani-One Asia announced on Tuesday and Wednesday that it has licensed the Hotel Inhumans season 2, Reincarnated as a Sword season 2, The Vermillion Mask , Vertex Force , and Uncle’s Obsession with Cute Things anime. All five anime will debut in October.
author: ANN

title: Aniplus Asia Airs Simulcast of Reborn as a Space Mercenary, Magical Explorer Anime
content: Aniplus Asia announced on Tuesday and Wednesday that it will air simulcasts of the Reborn as a Space Mercenary and Magical Explorer anime for the fall 2026 anime season. The television anime of Ryūto and Tetsuhiro Nabeshima 's Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
author: ANN

title: Now That We Draw Anime Reveals First Trailer, January 2027 Release Date
content: Now That We Draw anime revealed the first teaser trailer, along with new character visuals and a January 2027 release date. Shunsuke Ishikawa is directing the anime at studio ROLL2, with Deko Akao handling the series composition and Hiromi Nakagawa as the character designer.
author: Anime Corner

title: WEBTOON Launches 1st Global Drop With The Warrior's Ballad
content: WEBTOON Entertainment has launched its first "Global Drop" project with The Warrior's Ballad , releasing the fantasy webtoon simultaneously in nine languages on September 19. Global Drop is a new initiative that releases highly anticipated new and returning webtoons in multiple languages without a time delay between…

title: 'Kakunaru Ue wa' Reveals Additional Staff, First Promo for Winter 2027
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyuu Takahata and Yuuji Kaba 's Kakunaru Ue wa ( Now That We Draw ) manga revealed additional staff, a character visual (pictured above), and the first promotional video on Thursday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Snowball Earth Manga Heads to Final Arc, Exceeds 1 Million Copies in Circulation
content: Manga author Yuhiro Tsujitsugu announced on their X (formerly Twitter ) account on Thursday that their Snowball Earth manga has exceeded 1 million copies in circulation. Additionally, Tsujitsugu announced that the manga is starting its final arc.
author: ANN

title: 'Now That We Draw' Anime's 1st Full Promo Video Unveils More Staff, January 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Kyū Takahata and Yūji Kaba 's Now That We Draw ( Kakunaru Ue wa ) manga presented the anime's first full promotional video and character visuals on Thursday. The video announces additional staff members and the January 2027 premiere for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Bless Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed two more cast members in a character promotional video, on Thursday. Yoshino Aoyama will voice Oroka Sumeragi, and Momoka Terasawa will voice Shitataka Sumeragi.
author: ANN
